author: Partner Threat Feed
attributes.description: Identifies three or more hosts resolving command and control domains used by the Umber Gimlet loader, as reported in campaign PTF-00191. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Umber Gimlet Loader: Several hosts resolving command and control domains (PTF-00191)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Umber Gimlet Loader: Several hosts resolving command and control domains

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Umber Gimlet loader in campaign PTF-00191.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
attributes.query:
FROM logs-endpoint.events.network-*
| WHERE dns.question.name IN ("api-auth28.invalid", "cloud-login48.test", "data-static19.invalid", "media-auth76.example", "portal-node78.example", "secure-portal81.test", "sync-assets96.invalid")
| STATS host_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.id), hosts = VALUES(host.name) BY dns.question.name
| WHERE host_count >= 3
